US Senator Accuses Health Agency of Plan to Deport Migrant Children

Senator Ron Wyden of Oregon has accused the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) of preparing an "unprecedented legal framework" to deport over 500 migrant children. Wyden communicated this accusation in a letter addressed to Robert F. Kennedy Jr. The senator's statement suggests concerns about the administration's approach to the removal of unaccompanied migrant children.
